keyword.en: Concrete Pump Delivery Hose output and pumping distance inquiry
keyword.zh: 混凝土泵输送胶管输送量与输送距离询盘

title.en: Match output and distance to the Concrete Pump Delivery Hose page before you ask Xingtai
title.zh: 先把输送量和距离对照混凝土泵输送胶管页面，再向邢台询盘

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Concrete Pump Delivery Hose at /products/concrete-pump-delivery-hose. Copy only the printed cells: Part type Concrete pump delivery / placing hose; Ends Steel couplings, factory-protected for transport; Diameter / length Quoted after confirming the pump model; Packing Project
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把混凝土泵输送胶管列在 /products/concrete-pump-delivery-hose。只抄已印格子：配件类型 混凝土泵输送 / 布料胶管; 接头 金属接头，出厂防护包装; 管径 / 长度 对照泵型号后确认报价; 包装 工厂备货，按工程量包装; 商务条款 不支持小批量发货；无公开标价。这一页没有印理论输送量。不要自编 m³/h。向邢台问哪一条已列机型对得上你要的产量。这一页没有印水平/垂直距离。这一格留空，并向邢台询问。不要从另一个型号抄距离。这一页没有印电机千瓦或发动机额定值。说明现场是电网还是柴油，并向邢台询问。不要猜一个千瓦数。这一页没有印最大骨料或粒径。仍然把粒径发给邢台，问这一已列配件或机器是

h1.en: Output and distance decide whether the Concrete Pump Delivery Hose row fits
h1.zh: 输送量和距离决定混凝土泵输送胶管这一行是否合适

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists the Concrete Pump Delivery Hose at /products/concrete-pump-delivery-hose. Copy only the printed cells: Part type Concrete pump delivery / placing hose; Ends Steel couplings, factory-protected for transport; Diameter / length Quoted after confirming the pump model; Packing Project quantities from factory stock; Commercial terms No small-batch shipping; no published list price. This page does not print a theoretical output. Do not invent m³/h. Ask Xingtai which listed machine matches the rate you need. This page does not print a horizontal / vertical pair. Leave that cell blank and ask Xingtai. Do not copy a distance from a different model. This page does not print motor kilowatts or an engine rating. Say whether the site has grid power or diesel, and ask Xingtai. Do not guess a kilowatt number. This page does not print a maximum aggregate or particle size. Send the size anyway, and ask Xingtai whether this listed part or machine accepts it. OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/concrete-pump-delivery-hose. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai. The photograph on this note is a content image from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Masonry. It shows: Bridge over the Isábena river in the Monastery of Santa María de Obarra , masonry construction with stones. It is a reference picture for the inquiry topic. It is not a Hebei Pinjin Machinery nameplate, not a quotation, and not an export case.

body.en: Put /products/concrete-pump-delivery-hose in the subject. The published cells are: Part type Concrete pump delivery / placing hose; Ends Steel couplings, factory-protected for transport; Diameter / length Quoted after confirming the pump model; Packing Project quantities from factory stock; Commercial terms No small-batch shipping; no published list price. Leave any cell the page does not print empty.
body.zh: 主题里写上 /products/concrete-pump-delivery-hose。已公布的格子是：配件类型 混凝土泵输送 / 布料胶管; 接头 金属接头，出厂防护包装; 管径 / 长度 对照泵型号后确认报价; 包装 工厂备货，按工程量包装; 商务条款 不支持小批量发货；无公开标价。页面没有印的格子保持空白。

heading.en: Output, distance, power and particle size
heading.zh: 输送量、距离、动力和粒径

body.en: This page does not print a theoretical output. Do not invent m³/h. Ask Xingtai which listed machine matches the rate you need. This page does not print a horizontal / vertical pair. Leave that cell blank and ask Xingtai. Do not copy a distance from a different model. This page does not print motor kilowatts or an engine rating. Say whether the site has grid power or diesel, and ask Xingtai. Do not guess a kilowatt number. This page does not print a maximum aggregate or particle size. Send the size anyway, and ask Xingtai whether this listed part or machine accepts it.
body.zh: 这一页没有印理论输送量。不要自编 m³/h。向邢台问哪一条已列机型对得上你要的产量。这一页没有印水平/垂直距离。这一格留空，并向邢台询问。不要从另一个型号抄距离。这一页没有印电机千瓦或发动机额定值。说明现场是电网还是柴油，并向邢台询问。不要猜一个千瓦数。这一页没有印最大骨料或粒径。仍然把粒径发给邢台，问这一已列配件或机器是否接受。

heading.en: What to ask Xingtai instead of guessing
heading.zh: 该问邢台，而不是自己猜

body.en: OEM or a change starts from the listed model at /products/concrete-pump-delivery-hose. Send the change to Xingtai. Do not invent a model name or a performance number the page does not print. Also send country and purchase timing as facts about your order. Do not turn them into a promised lead time or an export-country list. No price is printed on the product page. Confirm the price with Xingtai.
body.zh: OEM 或改动从已列型号 /products/concrete-pump-delivery-hose 开始。把要改的内容发给邢台。不要自编型号，也不要写页面没有印的性能数字。同时把国家和采购时间作为订单事实发来。不要把它们写成承诺交期，也不要写成出口国名单。产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。

answer.zh: 产品页没有印价格。价格向邢台询盘确认。
